Came over on the Mayflower in 1620 as a servant in Edward Winslow's household, and signed the Mayflower Compact.
Married Mary Buckett, who came on the Anne in 1623; they settled at Duxbury, where he served as a deputy to the Plymouth
Colony court. His origins are unknown; he died in early 1680.
She came to Plymouth on the Anne in 1623 and married the Mayflower passenger George Soule there.
They moved to Duxbury, where they raised eight children, and George was among the original purchasers of Dartmouth.
She died at Duxbury in 1676 or 1677.
